cards.name: The Kind Reaperman
cards.creator: Dragoon
cards.effect: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. You can reveal this card in your hand; Banish 5 monsters in any GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card. (Quick Effect) .You can place 1 Finality Counter on each other monster on the field.(A monster with a Finality Counter is destroyed after activating an effect on the field and when it battles after Damage Calculation) If this card leaves the field: You can Special Summon any number of "Lesser Death Tokens" (Illusion/DARK/Level 1/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your Field, but they cannot be Tributed or used for a Fusion, Link or Synchro Summon. You can only use each effect of "The Kind Reaperman" once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Ghost
cards.creator: Heraldry Cosmos
cards.effect: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your hand or Deck, except “Terrorcarnation Ghost”, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck, except Zombies. If this card is destroyed by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation Token” (Zombie/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position, then if you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link monster, you can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your GY in Defense Position, except “Terrorcarnation Ghost”. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Ghost” once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Maiden
cards.effect: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can destroy 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your hand, and if you do, draw 2 cards. If this card is destroyed by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation Token” (Zombie/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position, then if you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link monster, you can destroy 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Maiden” once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Necromancer
cards.effect: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Terrorcarnation" monster from your Deck to your hand, except “Terrorcarnation Necromancer”. If this card is destroyed by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation Token” (Zombie/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position, then if you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link monster, you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Necromancer” once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Punished
cards.effect: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 “Terrorcarnation” Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed by a card effect: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation Token” (Zombie/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position, then if you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link monster, you can send 1 “Terrorcarnation” card from your Deck to the GY, except “Terrorcarnation Punished”. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Punished” once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Chant
cards.creator: Heraldry Cosmos
cards.effect: When you activate this card: You can destroy 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your hand, field, or Deck. When a monster is destroyed by battle while you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link Monster: You can target that destroyed monster; Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster’s original ATK. You can only use each effect of "Terrorcarnation Chant" once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Manifestation
cards.effect: Destroy 1 “Terrorcarnation” Effect monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your Deck with a different name. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY and target 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster in your GY: Add it to your hand, or if a monster was destroyed by a card effect this turn, Special Summon it instead. You can only use 1 effect of “Terrorcarnation Manifestation” once each turn, and only once that turn, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck the turn you use either, except Zombie Link Monsters.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Resurrection
cards.effect: When you activate this card: You can Special Summon 1 “Terrorcarnation” monster from your hand or GY. When your opponent takes Battle Damage while you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link Monster: You can draw 1 card, also make all monsters your opponent controls lose ATK equal to the damage. You can only use each effect of "Terrorcarnation Resurrection" once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Sighting
cards.effect: When you activate this card: You can shuffle up to 3 “Terrorcarnation” monsters from your GY to the Deck. Once per turn, when a card or effect is activated while you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link Monster in the Extra Monster Zone: You can destroy 2 “Terrorcarnation” monsters you control, and if you do, negate that effect. You can only use each effect of "Terrorcarnationg Sighting" once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Crow
cards.creator: Heraldry Cosmos
cards.effect:
2 "Terrorcarnation" monsters
This co-linked card can attack directly. If this card is Special Summoned: You can set 1 “Terrorcarnation” Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY. During your opponent’s turn, if a card was destroyed by a card effect this turn and you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Crow” once per turn, and you cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck the turn you activate either, except Zombie Link Monsters.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Cryptid
cards.effect:
2+ Zombie monsters
This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while it points to a monster. If this card battles an opponent’s monster, this card gains ATK equal to the opposing monster’s original ATK. (Quick Effect): You can destroy all monsters this card points to, then you can destroy up to 2 face-up cards on the field. You can only use this effect of “Terrorcarnation Cryptid” once per turn.

cards.name: Terrorcarnation Hound
cards.effect:
2 "Terrorcarnation" monsters
Your opponent cannot target this co-linked card for attacks or with card effects. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target up to 3 cards in your opponent’s GY; Banish them. During your opponent’s turn, if a card was destroyed by a card effect this turn and you control a “Terrorcarnation” Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use each effect of “Terrorcarnation Hound” once per turn, and you cannot Special Summon monsters from your Extra Deck the turn you activate either, except Zombie Link Monsters.
